daily-goal.title: Your garden is waiting
daily-goal.body: A few pages, and its water keeps flowing.

water-stopped.title: The water has stopped
water-stopped.body: The water in your garden has stopped flowing. One page starts it again.

thirsty.title: Your garden is thirsty
thirsty.body: Its plants are waiting for a little water.

wilting.title: Your garden is wilting
wilting.body: It is holding on: a few pages will lift it back up.

dying.title: Your garden needs you
dying.body: Its elements are starting to fade. Nothing is lost.

last-chance.title: Your garden is still holding on
last-chance.body: It can come back to life today.

dead.title: Your garden has dried out
dead.body: The soil remembers everything. One page, and the water returns.

come-back.title: Your garden is still here
come-back.body: It will wait for you. One page is enough for the water to return.
